title: Examples audit inventory — streaming / tool calling / structured output (SDKs + docs + quickstarts)
notes:
Purpose: single inventory of every snippet that shows (a) token streaming, (b) tool calling (single + parallel), and (c) structured output/schema validation.

How to read:
- Status: OK = matches canonical event model + copy/paste runnable; Needs update = drift or ambiguous; Replace = delete legacy snippet and link to canonical; Missing = we don’t have the example where users expect it.
- Priority: P0 = known support driver / frequently copied; P1 = important parity; P2 = nice-to-have.

Last sweep: 2026-02-07 (post PR landings in SDK repos; docs PRs pending final deploy).

Owners:
- Python: Monica Patel (exec), Ibrahim Khan (TL), implementation: Sabrina James
- TS: Dana Lo
- Go: Mateusz Zielinski
- Docs-site: Elliot Price + Wei Chen

Known drift themes to watch for:
- streaming: final response not captured; confusing event names; reconnect guidance missing
- tools: partial args deltas treated as complete JSON; unsafe tool dispatch; parallel tool concurrency not constrained
- structured output: schema mismatch errors not explained; validation/retry pattern missing; older docs used stale schema keywords
